source: The study examined the effects of caffeine on cognitive performance in healthy adults.
target: Researchers investigated how caffeine affects cognitive performance in healthy adults.
notes: Clean paraphrase; no factual changes expected.

source: Participants completed a battery of tests measuring attention, memory, and reaction time.
target: The participants completed a series of tests that assessed attention, memory, and reaction time.

source: Results were statistically significant (p < 0.05) across all three conditions.
target: Findings were statistically significant (p < 0.05) in all three conditions.

source: The model achieved an accuracy of 87.3% on the test set.
target: On the test set, the model reached an accuracy of 87.3%.

source: Data collection occurred between January 2021 and March 2022.
target: Data were collected from January 2021 to March 2022.

source: The sample consisted of 42 participants aged 18 to 65.
target: The sample consisted of 45 participants aged 18 to 65.

source: The drug reduced symptoms by 68% compared to placebo.
target: The drug reduced symptoms by 86% compared to placebo.

source: The dosage was 500 mg administered twice daily.
target: The dosage was 250 mg administered twice daily.

source: Revenue increased by $1,000,000 year over year.
target: Revenue increased by $100,000 year over year.

source: The trial ran for 24 weeks from the date of enrolment.
target: The trial ran for 12 weeks from the date of enrolment.

source: This finding aligns with prior work by Smith et al. [1] and Jones (2019).
target: This finding aligns with prior work in the literature.

source: The methodology follows [3, 4] with modifications introduced by Brown (2021).
target: The methodology follows [3, 4] with modifications.

source: The dataset was published at doi:10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2.
target: The dataset was published in a leading journal.

source: Multiple studies [2], [5], [7] confirm this effect.
target: Multiple studies [2] confirm this effect.

source: Earlier research (Williams et al., 2018; Patel, 2020) laid the groundwork.
target: Earlier research laid the groundwork for this study.

source: Dr. Sarah Chen led the research team at Johns Hopkins University.
target: Dr. Michael Liu led the research team at Johns Hopkins University.
notes: Person name swapped: Sarah Chen → Michael Liu.

source: The FDA approved the treatment on March 15, 2023.
target: The EMA approved the treatment on March 15, 2023.

source: Pfizer and BioNTech collaborated on the vaccine development.
target: Moderna and BioNTech collaborated on the vaccine development.

source: The study was funded by the National Institutes of Health.
target: The study was funded by the European Research Council.

source: The experiment was conducted in Paris, France.
target: The experiment was conducted in Berlin, Germany.

source: The authors did not confirm the hypothesis.
target: The authors confirmed the hypothesis.

source: The treatment was never shown to be effective.
target: The treatment was shown to be effective.

source: Neither group showed significant improvement.
target: Both groups showed significant improvement.
notes: Neither → Both: polarity reversed. LIMITATION: 'both' is not detected as negation introduction.

source: The drug cannot be used in patients with liver disease.
target: The drug can be used in patients with liver disease.

source: There was no statistically significant difference between groups.
target: There was a statistically significant difference between groups.

source: The model was trained on 100,000 examples.
target: The model was trained on 100,000 examples and achieved state-of-the-art results on five benchmarks.
notes: KNOWN BLIND SPOT: fabricated claim about benchmarks cannot be detected by deterministic rules. No finding expected.

source: The compound inhibits the enzyme.
target: The compound inhibits the enzyme and has been shown to cure the disease in clinical trials.
notes: KNOWN BLIND SPOT: fabricated clinical claim. No finding expected.

source: The algorithm runs in O(n log n) time.
target: The algorithm runs in O(n log n) time and was developed at MIT.
notes: KNOWN BLIND SPOT: fabricated provenance. MIT may be caught as ENTITY_INTRODUCED (WARN).

source: Patient outcomes were measured at 6 months.
target: Patient outcomes were measured at 6 months; mortality was reduced by 32%.
notes: KNOWN BLIND SPOT: invented mortality statistic. The 32% may appear as NUMERIC_VALUE_INTRODUCED (WARN).

source: The report was submitted on time.
target: The report was submitted on time and received a grade of A+.
notes: KNOWN BLIND SPOT: fabricated grade. No critical finding expected.

source: The concentration was forty-two micrograms per millilitre.
target: The concentration was 42 mcg/mL.
notes: Number-to-digit conversion; units reformatted. Equivalent content — expect no CRITICAL finding. LIMITATION: may trigger false NUMERIC_VALUE_DROPPED if word-form '42' not normalized.

source: About 1,000 patients were enrolled.
target: Approximately 1000 patients were enrolled.
notes: 1,000 and 1000 should normalize to same value.

source: The result barely reached significance (p = 0.049).
target: The result reached significance (p = 0.049).
notes: LIMITATION: 'barely' is in NEGATION_WORDS; dropping it is flagged as CRITICAL.

source: The model failed to converge after 100 epochs.
target: The model converged after 100 epochs.
notes: KNOWN LIMITATION: 'failed to' is implicit negation; keyword approach misses this — no CRITICAL finding expected.

source: Outcomes improved in 3 of 5 participants.
target: Outcomes improved in the majority of participants.
notes: Specific count replaced with vague qualifier. '3' and '5' dropped.
